title: invoiced's dedicated log file stopped getting new entries
description_md:
`invoiced` logs through the system journal like everything else on this box, and `journalctl -t invoiced` proves its messages are still arriving there just fine. But the dedicated file the billing team actually tails, `/var/log/invoiced/invoiced.log` (filed there by a legitimate rsyslog rule that depends on rsyslog receiving what journald forwards it), hasn't gotten a single new line in a while. SSH in as `trainee` (passwordless `sudo`), work out why journald's messages aren't making it to rsyslog anymore, and fix the pipeline.

You're done when a fresh `invoiced` message shows up in `/var/log/invoiced/invoiced.log`.
